files.justification: GATE 4 default: symbols (MenuRefreshData, _build_version, _get_app_version, _month_since, _window_since, _project_short, TelemetryMenubarApp) all serve one shared responsibility: the menubar app class and the small version/date helpers it consumes directly. No nameable independent unrelated cluster.
GATE 4 default: line_count=296 < 350 split eligibility floor. Single responsibility: classify tool-window events via ClassifyEngine and its WindowConfig/_matches_any/_scan_tool_window helpers.

GATE 4 default: single shared responsibility is menubar config file format, parsing, and persistence — _load_config/_save_config/_config_to_text/_parse_config_text/_apply_* all collaborate on one config-management pipeline; no independent cluster.

GATE 3 naming test: cluster A 'widget text renderers' (_render_header_text, _render_tips_text, _tool_event_detail, _event_input_detail, _render_cls_group, _tool_stat_detail, _tip_detail, _agent_detail) return markup strings consumed by Textual widgets; cluster B 'static console renderers' (_print_tool_stats_panel, _print_agents_panel, _render_timeline_line, _stats_duration_str, _stats_session_label, _efficiency_color, _render_stats_panel, _render_stats_compact) print Rich panels for the static print_summary path. Module docstring confirms dual consumers ('used by both Textual widgets and static print_summary'). Neither cluster calls the other; both only depend on shared _formatters/_constants imports, no shared mutable module state.
GATE 4 default: line_count=233 < 350. Single responsibility: parse rotated OTLP jsonl records into accumulated metrics/attrs for the menubar.
GATE 2: created_by_prior_split=true, splitting already failed on this file.

GATE 4 default: single shared responsibility is the cost-analysis pipeline — get_all_costs/get_daily_costs/get_model_performance and their aggregation helpers all collaborate deeply; no independent cluster.
